newsitem.title: USA: D.H. Marketing Q4 shr $0.40 pretax.
newsitem.headline: D.H. Marketing Q4 shr $0.40 pretax.

text.p: D.H. Marketing & Consulting Inc on Friday said its fourth-quarter pretax earnings rose to $0.40 per share from $0.24 in the third quarter.
It said it had not yet released its results on an after-tax basis.
The company, in existence two years and traded publicly for one, said it expected to post first-quarter 1997 earnings of $0.50 per share, a 25 percent increase from the fourth quarter.
The company said in a release that 1996 pretax earnings were $0.80 per share, compared with a loss of $0.18 per share for fiscal 1995.
D.H. Marketing also said it expected to announce a three-for-one stock split at the end of the first quarter.
